title: OpenAI head of robotics resigns after deal with Pentagon
title_zh: OpenAI 机器人技术负责人在与五角大楼达成协议后辞职
summary: Caitlin Kalinowski, head of robotics and consumer hardware at OpenAI, announced her resignation ‌on Saturday, citing concerns about the company's agreement with ‌the Department of Defense.
summary_zh: OpenAI 机器人和消费硬件主管凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基 (Caitlin Kalinowski) 于周六宣布辞职，理由是对该公司与国防部达成协议的担忧。

title: Qualcomm has 'significant advantage' over Nvidia in edge AI: CFO
title_zh: 高通首席财务官：在边缘人工智能领域比英伟达拥有“显着优势”
summary: Mobile tech conference Mobile World Congress took place in Barcelona last week, where Qualcomm (QCOM) outlined its artificial intelligence (AI) strategy and upcoming innovations.
summary_zh: 移动技术会议世界移动大会上周在巴塞罗那举行，高通 (QCOM) 概述了其人工智能 (AI) 战略和即将推出的创新。

title: The Weekend: Iran war shakes markets and rattles energy sector
title_zh: 周末：伊朗战争震动市场并扰乱能源行业
summary: Iran conflict overshadowed UK spring statement as fears over energy supplies and inflation persisted
summary_zh: 由于对能源供应和通胀的担忧持续存在，伊朗冲突给英国春季声明蒙上阴影

title: Formula 1 and Apple's big gamble kicks off this weekend
title_zh: 一级方程式赛车和苹果的豪赌将于本周末拉开帷幕
summary: A big change is coming in the all-important US market for F1: Gone is ESPN, which offered up the sport of F1 to the masses, and in its place is tech giant Apple.
summary_zh: 对于 F1 至关重要的美国市场正在发生重大变化：向大众提供 F1 运动的 ESPN 已经不复存在，取而代之的是科技巨头苹果。
